_comment: Tool-facing hardware/address declaration for the Konami Frogger board (parent set `frogger`).
This is the Galaxian/Scramble family (MAME src/mame/galaxian/galaxian.cpp), NOT the konami/
driver our pooyan/timeplt boards come from -- a genuinely NEW board, not a fork. Read from
inputs@5228, gfx layouts@7391; and galaxian_v.cpp: galaxian_palette@238, RGB_MAXIMUM@229.
Numbers are decimal (JSON has no 0x); '_hex'/'_note' fields are annotations the loader ignores.
★ MEASURED from a MAME run (SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy, fresh -cfg_directory, -noreadconfig defaults):
controlByte=0x3A (ROM[0x0000]), IN1=0xFC, IN2=0xF1, and the Z80 reset state, all at t=0 -- and the
IN1/IN2 program-space reads equal the direct ioport reads. STILL UNMEASURED: landmarks (need boot-
init-done + first-vblank-NMI cycles). dsw0 below points at IN2 because galaxian interleaves the dips
into IN1/IN2 with no standalone DSW port; the shared checker certifies one port (IN2).

screen._note: galaxian_base set_raw(PIXEL_CLOCK=18.432MHz, HTOTAL=1152, HBEND 0, HBSTART 768, VTOTAL 264, VBEND 16, VBSTART 240) -> visible 256x224. ROT90 (portrait), same orientation as timeplt/pooyan. XSCALE=3 internal render is IGNORABLE for Frogger (no starfield); render native 256 wide. galaxian.cpp:7498-7501, galaxian.h:47-56.

_refresh_note: 18.432e6 / (HTOTAL 1152 * VTOTAL 264) = 60.6060... -- the dkong/pooyan figure, NOT timeplt's exact 60. galaxian.cpp:7498.
_cycles_note: 3072000 / 60.606061 = 50688. Same as pooyan/dkong (shared refresh), differs from timeplt (51200).

stateRegions.name: objram
stateRegions._hex: 0xB000-0xB0FF OBJRAM/spriteram (per-column scroll+color 0x00-0x3F, 8 sprites 0x40-0x5F, bullets 0x60-0x7F) mirror 0x0700 -- frogger_map@2422

writeRanges.name: irq_enable
writeRanges._hex: 0xB808 irq_enable_w D0 = NMI-ON latch (mirror MASK 0x07E3 -> decode addr&0xF81C==0xB808) -- frogger_map@2423, irq_enable_w@779

writeRanges.name: ppi_window
writeRanges._hex: 0xC000-0xFFFF frogger_ppi8255_w: A13(0x2000)->PPI0, A12(0x1000)->PPI1, port=(off>>1)&3. Sound latch=0xD000(PPI1.A), sound ctrl=0xD002(PPI1.B). -- frogger_map@2428, frogger_ppi8255_w@1152

_watchdog_note: 0x8800 mirror 0x07FF is a READ (watchdog reset_r), not a write; reset_r pets the dog and returns space.unmap()=0xFF (unmap_value_high). frogger_map@2420.
_inputs_note: There is NO separate DSW port: the dip bits are interleaved into IN1/IN2 (galaxian.cpp:5228-5269). All input bits are IP_ACTIVE_LOW (idle high). Idle values below are DERIVED from the DIPSETTING defaults (all 0x00), NOT measured from MAME.

IN0._bits: b0=UP(cocktail,4way) b2=SERVICE1 b4=RIGHT(4way) b5=LEFT(4way) b6=COIN2 b7=COIN1; b1,b3 unused. idle 0xFF.

IN1._bits: b0-1=DSW Lives(default 0x00=3) b4=RIGHT(cocktail) b5=LEFT(cocktail) b6=START2 b7=START1; b2,b3 unused. idle = 0xFF & ~0x03 (Lives default) = 0xFC. ✓ MEASURED 0xFC at t=0 (== direct ioport read).

IN2._bits: b0=DOWN(cocktail) b1-2=DSW Coinage(default 0x00=1/1) b3=DSW Cabinet(default 0x00=upright) b4=UP(4way) b6=DOWN(4way); b5,b7 unused. idle = 0xFF & ~0x0E = 0xF1. ✓ MEASURED 0xF1 at t=0 (== direct ioport read).

IN3._bits: IPT_UNUSED, all bits 0x00. 'need for some PPI accesses'. galaxian.cpp:5267.

dsw0._hex_expected: 0xF1 -- MEASURED at t=0 from a MAME -noreadconfig run, all dips default. Galaxian has NO standalone DSW port; the shared config-probe certifies IN2 = Coinage(b1-2)+Cabinet(b3, screen-flip), the config most able to corrupt a golden. IN1/Lives (0xE002=0xFC) is recorded as dsw1 by the dumpers but NOT verified by the shared single-DSW0 checker.

_controlByte_hex: 0x3A -- ROM[0x0000] first byte (LD A,(nn)); config-probe that the program ROM loaded. MEASURED from a MAME run (== games/frogger/rom/maincpu.bin byte 0). Non-0xFF, so it distinguishes a real read from this board's 0xFF unmapped-read float.

z80Reset._hex: MAME Z80 reset: AF=0x0040 (Z flag set), IX=IY=0xFFFF, rest 0 -- same for every MAME Z80

interrupt._note: vblank_interrupt_w asserts INPUT_LINE_NMI only while irq_enable_w's D0 latch (0xB808) is set; clearing it clears the line. Same model as timeplt/dkong. galaxian.cpp:761-767,779-787, galaxian.h:435.
